definitions.explanation: A way through or along which people can walk. A path or walkway connecting two areas.
A walkway between rows of seats or shelves.

examples.japanese: {通路|つうろ}に{荷物|にもつ}を{置|お}かないでください。
examples.english: Please don't leave luggage in the aisle.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}の{通路|つうろ}{側|がわ}の{席|せき}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I reserved an aisle seat on the plane.

examples.japanese: {非常|ひじょう}{通路|つうろ}を{確保|かくほ}してください。
examples.english: Please keep the emergency exit clear.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通路|つうろ}{側|がわ} (aisle side)
- {窓|まど}{側|がわ} (window side - opposite)
- {非常|ひじょう}{通路|つうろ} (emergency passage)
- {地下|ちか}{通路|つうろ} (underground passage)
- {通路|つうろ}を{塞|ふさ}ぐ (to block the aisle)

TRAVEL USAGE:
- {通路|つうろ}{側|がわ}の{席|せき} (aisle seat) vs {窓|まど}{側|がわ}の{席|せき} (window seat)

SAFETY:
- {避難|ひなん}{通路|つうろ} (evacuation route)
- {通路|つうろ}を{確保|かくほ}する (to secure passage)
